notes:
Account: programmatic ad exchange focusing on sub-50ms p95 reranking for auction path. Customer very cost sensitive — wants <$0.0008 per request at scale. Primary ask: benchmark real workload (cold start & steady-state) and guidance on batching/caching/quantization to hit latency + cost targets.

Recent calls: short discovery -> architecture deep-dive -> security sync. AE/SE positioning Redwood Dedicated with Private control plane (VPC) plus Optimize recommendations. Customer said: "We can't accept any >50ms tail on rerank hop or we lose auctions."

Key points from SE call (Diego):
- Workload: reranking for RTB auctions (~200 token prompts, often similar prefixes).
- Traffic profile: bursty at minute-level, predictable diurnal patterns; peak 800 qps sustained during campaigns, spikes to 3k qps for 10-30s.
- Targets: p95 end-to-end <50ms for rerank, cold p95 <200ms, target throughput 1.2k steady.
- Cost: target <$0.0008/request on average; cost sensitivity pushes for aggressive quantization + batching.
- Model preference: small-to-medium open LLMs (Llama-2-13B or similar distilled variants); willing to evaluate quantized INT4 and hybrid FP16/INT8 paths.
- Routing/fallback: prefer primary Dedicated pool in us-east with fallback to hosted low-priority pool; need automated fallback policy and per-route budgets.
- Observability: token-level cost and latency breakdown, per-request traces required for auction debugging.

POC plan (agreed):
1) Provide sample production trace + representative prompt sets (Anchor to deliver by 2025-02-21).
2) Redwood to spin POC Dedicated cluster with identical model variant + quantized builds (FP16, INT8, INT4) and run perf matrix (latency, p95, throughput, cost).
3) Run steady-state load (1.2k qps) and short spike tests (3k qps) to validate autoscaling/burst.
4) Test caching strategies: prefix/KV caching for common prefixes, evaluate hit-rate improvements and end-to-end tail reductions.
5) Deliver ops playbook: batching config, cache TTLs, quantization tradeoff table, and recommended routing policies.

Sticking points / concerns:
- Security team requires iso27001 in addition to SOC2; on-prem package preferred for PII-adjacent user ids.
- Legal needs a revised SLA + encryption at rest proof (HSM/KMS integration).
- Finance pushing to cap monthly committed spend; needs clearer unit economics to sign Dedicated commit.

Sales notes / guidance:
- Emphasize Optimize ROI: show cost delta FP16->INT8->INT4 with quality regression examples on their eval prompts.
- Recommend initial canary with hosted API to validate logic, then move to Dedicated private cluster for strict latency.
- Ask for small initial reserved capacity (3-4 GPUs equivalent) for baseline, then autoscale policy to cover spikes.
